exposure: separate injections of hyperbaric bupivacaine, fentanyl, and morphine
premixed hyperbaric bupivacaine, fentanyl, and morphine
finding: The study found that sequential injection of intrathecal opioids and hyperbaric bupivacaine resulted in greater early haemodynamic instability and slightly better postoperative analgesia without any difference in block height or patient satisfaction.
